_DEPRECATED_2026_06_07_M2: CLASSIC branch protection is RETIRED — superseded by the RULESET model (scripts/repo-management/pin_branch_protection_rulesets.py + terraform/github-branch-protection/main.tf). The live required check is the per-repo 'Quality Gates (<repo>) / quality-gates-v2' on main + 'check-staging-lock' on staging — NOT the generic 'quality-gates' below (a DEAD context). Both consumers (apply-branch-protection.sh, set-branch-protection.sh) hard-refuse to run. Kept as a tombstone only.
_comment_purpose: Canonical GitHub branch protection spec. Applied per-branch by scripts/propagation/apply-branch-protection.sh. Null-valued fields are explicit to clear stale settings from previous ad-hoc configs.
_comment_required_status_checks: Contexts must match the 'job name' in each repo's GHA workflow (.github/workflows/*.yml) — typically 'quality-gates'. If a repo has no GHA check wired up yet, apply the template WITHOUT the context and add it after the workflow lands.
_comment_enforce_admins_false: enforce_admins=false is the admin-bypass escape hatch. IggyIkenna (org admin) can merge past a failing 'quality-gates' check by using --admin-override-coverage in quickmerge + admin-merge on GitHub. Non-admins see a hard block because they can't bypass branch protection.
_comment_0_approver: 0 required human approvals (codified 2026-06-02): for AUTONOMOUS CI/CD, a green required status check (quality-gates-v2) IS the review. A mandatory human approval blocks agent-opened PRs from auto-merging, defeating the gate. enforce_admins=true (in the ruleset model) keeps the GATE binding everyone — no one merges past a red gate. The PR-before-merge requirement stays (count=0 still requires a PR, just no approval). Re-introduce human review only as a deliberate per-repo policy, never as the default.
_comment_force_push_disabled: Force-pushes would let anyone rewrite history past the quality-gates check. Disabled for all protected branches.
